text:
arya: Hey team — pre-launch ask. We need a compact benchmark diagram + social cutdowns for the upcoming webinar (April 14). Main use: webinar slide, hero blog image, 3x social tiles, and a 1-pager PDF for SDRs.

zoe: Got it — can you share the copy & a rough visual direction?

arya: Copy is here: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/webinar-copy (TL;DR: 'Serving wins: lower cost per useful token — batching, KV cache, model routing'). We want a simple flow: request -> routing -> cache/batch -> inference -> savings. Emphasize latency and $/token tradeoff. Keep diagrams minimal, brand-safe.

mike: ETA? We have pre-launch review on Apr 9. Prefer final assets by Apr 7 so comms + legal can review.

zoe: I can do initial comps by Apr 1. Question: do you want an animated GIF of the flow for socials or static?

arya: Static first, one optional micro-anim for X/LinkedIn if time. Focus on a single visual system so hero + tiles feel related.

sam: Brand notes — two mandatory things: 1) use primary palette for hero, secondary palette for social tiles (muted). 2) ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text. No custom typefaces outside brand. Include alt text in the deliverable manifest.

zoe: Copy that. I'll follow the brand tokens in Figma. Will produce: hero (1920x1080 PNG + SVG), slide-ready SVG for Keynote/Slides, three socials (1200x628, 1080x1080, 1080x1920), 1-pager PDF (A4 letter). Also a source Figma file and export presets.

mike: Please include these export specs exactly in the export folder. I added a small checklist in the shared drive.

zoe: Adding specs here so it's explicit:
```
- hero: 1920x1080 @2x export, SVG source
- slide: 1280x720 SVG + PNG
- social_1: 1200x628 JPG (share preview)
- social_2: 1080x1080 PNG (transparent where possible)
- social_3: 1080x1920 PNG (for stories)
- 1-pager: PDF + editable InDesign/Figma
- micro-anim: 800x800 GIF (optional)
- include: alt text .csv, Figma link, source SVGs, .sketch export
```

arya: Nice. Also include a simplified 2-color variant for dark backgrounds and a version with data callouts (three short metrics: latency p50, cost per 1k tokens, throughput improvement).

zoe: Will do. Quick Q on metrics wording — should they be absolute numbers or relative percent improvements?

arya: Use relative % (e.g., ~35% cost reduction) and add a footnote: 'sample workload; results vary by model/sequence length.' Keep number of callouts to 3 max.

sam: I'll run an accessibility quick-pass after comps. Zoe, please flag any color variants that fail.

mike: Ops ask — package source files into a release folder with this name: `webinar-bench-release-2026-04-07`. Upload to Marketing Drive and drop the public-ish link in this thread when ready. Also we need a single-sheet PNG for SDR email hero sized 600x200.

zoe: Noted, adding 600x200 PNG to list. I'll aim for first comps Apr 1 and finish by Apr 6.

arya: Thanks. One more: can you add two headline copy variants for each social tile (short & long) so A/B can run? Keep them in a simple CSV with copy_id and character counts.

zoe: Will include CSV.

deploy-bot: File uploaded: figma://redwood/marketing/webinar-bench-v1 (preview available) :white_check_mark:

mike: Saw the upload. Zoe — ping me when comps are in Figma and I'll create the release folder.

zoe: Uploaded first comp to the figma link. Notes on frames: hero_v1, hero_v1_dark, social_sq_v1, social_land_v1, social_vert_v1, onepager_v1.

arya: Reviewing now. Quick nit: swap the icons for the routing stage to line icons (instead of filled) for better legibility at small sizes.

zoe: Done. Updated files and exported the 600x200 PNG. Dropping the link to drive export: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/webinar-bench-release-2026-04-01

mike: Moving to release folder. Tagging legal for checklist: @sam please confirm once you've done brand & accessibility pass.

sam: Brand pass complete. Accessibility notes: hero contrast good, social_land needs slight text-size bump for 1200x628. I left comments in Figma.

zoe: Adjusted sizes per comments. Final export scheduled Apr 6. Will add alt text CSV and copy variants.

arya: Amazing — thanks everyone. If anything blocks, ping me directly. :sparkles:
